warrantyAndTrial.warranty: 15-Year Comprehensive Direct Factory Warranty covering sagging > 0.75", core disintegration, or coil failure with free doorstep replacement.
warrantyAndTrial.trial: 100-Night Risk-Free Sleep Trial at home. If you do not love your sleep, we pick it up flat from your bedroom with a 100% full refund.
warrantyAndTrial.medicalDisclaimer: LORA mattresses provide ergonomic orthopaedic alignment and pressure relief. We never claim to cure medical diseases or replace certified medical treatment.

deliveryPolicies.method: 100% Flat Uncompressed White-Glove Doorstep Delivery directly from LORA Works bay.
deliveryPolicies.zeroVacuum: We NEVER roll or vacuum-compress our luxury mattresses into boxes. Compression crushes steel spring borders and degrades high-density foams.
deliveryPolicies.timeline: Metro & Tier-1 Hubs (Bengaluru, Kochi, Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad): 2 to 4 business days. Other pin codes: 4 to 7 business days.
deliveryPolicies.shippingCost: 100% Free Shipping across India with full transit insurance.

emiAndPayment.emi: 0% Interest No-Cost EMI available for 3, 6, 9, and 12 months through all major credit cards and Bajaj Finserv via Razorpay.
emiAndPayment.prepaid: Instant UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Debit/Credit Cards, NetBanking with 256-Bit SSL protection.
emiAndPayment.cod: Cash / UPI on Delivery available up to ₹50,000 in serviceable postal zones.
